function: Excluded, above_phy: the quantum federated RL agent learns V2V mode selection, sub-channel assignment, and discrete transmit power (p. 8); STAR-RIS coefficients are not learned (p. 5, 8).
notes: Title and p. 1 abstract: joint mode selection and resource allocation for a STAR-RIS-aided vehicle-road system. p. 8, action space: "power control; b) SC allocation; and c) mode selection". These are radio resource management decisions of a terrestrial V2X network (scheduling and association type), which I treat as above the physical layer. The STAR-RIS has 50 elements (p. 3) and its coefficients are defined in Sec. II-D (p. 5) but are not part of the action or optimized anywhere, so no RIS configuration, beam, or precoder is learned; EVU and BS have one antenna (Table IV, p. 11). Federated aggregation is digital at a central server (p. 9), so not area 7. Judgment call for the reviewer: if transmit power control is counted as a physical-layer decision, the work passes above_phy and then fails function (it solves none of the seven areas); the decision stays exclude. Quantitative results exist (Fig. 4-6, p. 12), and the channel follows a 3GPP urban street scenario (p. 10), but neither changes the exclusion.
